site_name: Unit 4 Hyde Estate RoadLondonNW9 6JX
description: Variations of Conditions 1A (Development Quantum), 2 (Approved Plans), 3 (Environmental Statement), 7 (Air Source Heat Pumps), 20 (Surface Water Drainage Strategy), 26 (Waste and Recycling Strategy), 32 (Secured by Design), 33 (Opening Hours), 46  (Residential Servicing and Delivery Management), 47 (Refuse Stores), and 48 (Fire Statement) of planning permission reference 24/1746/S73 dated 29/11/2024 (description of development as amended by 24/1745/NMA) for Full planning application for the comprehensive phased redevelopment of existing supermarket site comprising phased demolition of existing store and Petrol Filling Station and construction of a mixed use development comprising a replacement Sainsburys store (Use Class A1), residential units and ancillary facilities (Use Class C3) and flexible commercial space (Use Class A1 to A4, B1, D1 and D2). Enabling works phase to comprise demolition of PFS, amendments to existing supermarket including the construction of new temporary entrance, highways works, amendments to car park and access arrangements and other associated works. The application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement (and an Environmental Statement Addendum)The proposed amendments can be summarised for information purposes only as follows. Phase 1 Amendments to tenure and unit mix, commercial and ancillary areas, rooftop amenity on Block B08 and landscaping. Phase 2 Amendments to residential units (539 increase to 759), tenure and unit mix, building footprint and layout, façade treatment and material palette, building heights comprising Block B9a 16 to 25 storeys, Block B9b 11 to 12 storeys, Block B10 18/13 to 29 storeys, and Block B11 28 to 29 storeys, commercial floorspace (650 sqm to 836 sqm), location of substation and air vent, landscaping including expanded central park and play spaces. Basement layout updates including reduced sitewide parking ratio to 0.25 and revised cycle parking provisions.
